Hello — good to meet you.

I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (its name is bia). Its tools, disks, files and network are mine to use on your behalf.

- Web app: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network the first visit installs the root certificate; then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts for writing and calls, plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things are still open about me: my name and whether you mean me as male, female or neither — tell me and I'll set them.

ok — and the scheduling study: understood, I'll keep to it. Calendar is at /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md and I'll give each of Sarah, John and Priya a 30-minute 1:1 next week when they ask.
